name: adam-derivation
title: ADaM derivation with variable-level lineage
description: Derive the ADaM datasets an ADaM spec demands from SDTM. The AI writes the R programs; deterministic steps run them in a fresh session, enforce a clean log, trace every variable to the program lines that make it (lineage.json from @derive tags) and generate the Define-XML from what was actually derived. Gate failures go back to the AI with the exact problems, within at most three attempts in total. Runs standalone (upload SDTM + adam-spec.json) or inside a parent workflow (study package in the trigger), including a fix loop: given CORE findings a reviewer marked 'fix', the AI changes only the code blocks behind the flagged variables.
preamble: CDISC terms (SDTM, ADaM, ADaMIG, ADSL, BDS, OCCDS, Define-XML, controlled terminology, population flags, CORE rule IDs, USUBJID) are technical workflow content.

triggerInput.name: package
triggerInput.description: Study package from a parent workflow: { study, profile, files: [{ name, downloadUrl, kind, sha256 }] } with kinds sdtm and adam-spec (plus, on a fix loop, adam-program, lineage, core-dispositions-adamig, core-report-adamig). Leave empty to upload by hand.

steps.name: Resolve inputs
steps.description: Deterministic. Picks SDTM, the ADaM spec and - on a fix loop - the previous programs, lineage and CORE findings from the study package, or routes to the upload step.

steps.name: Upload SDTM and ADaM spec
steps.description: Upload the SDTM datasets (one SAS V5 .xpt or .sas7bdat per domain, named after it: dm.xpt, suppdm.xpt) and adam-spec.json. Optionally the SDTM define.xml and analysis-spec.json. To fix existing programs, add them (.R) with lineage.json, core-dispositions-adamig.json and core-report.json from the ADaM validation.

steps.name: Stage inputs
steps.description: Deterministic. sha256-verifies every input (a missing or swapped file fails the step; nothing falls back to other data), stages SDTM and the spec under /workspace/adam-derivation/inputs, and on a fix loop restores the previous programs and extracts the CORE findings marked 'fix' with example records.

steps.name: Write ADaM programs
steps.description: AI. Writes one R program per ADaM dataset (admiral) to /workspace/programs, driven by adam-spec.json and the mandatory derivation rules, with an @derive tag above the code that makes each variable. Runs the same gates as the next steps (self_check.py) before finishing. On a retry it fixes the gate's problems; on a fix loop it changes only the blocks behind the CORE findings. It writes code only - the numbers come from the next step.

agent.prompt: You are the ADaM programmer for this run. Read /artifacts/skill/SKILL.md now and follow it exactly; its references are in /artifacts/skill/references/. Inputs are under /workspace/adam-derivation/inputs/. If /workspace/adam-derivation/feedback.json exists this is a retry: fix exactly the problems it lists. If /workspace/adam-derivation/inputs/core-findings.json lists findings this is a fix loop: change only the code behind them. Finish only when `python3 /artifacts/scripts/self_check.py` prints PASS (or you have documented why it cannot), then write /output/result.json as the skill describes.

steps.name: Execute programs
steps.description: Deterministic. Runs every program in its own fresh Rscript session in dependency order (ADSL first) against the staged SDTM only. Fails on any ERROR or WARNING in a log, a missing label, or a column SAS V5 cannot hold. Exports adam/<dataset>.xpt and publishes logs/ and the exact programs/ that ran.

steps.name: Check lineage
steps.description: Deterministic. Builds lineage.json from the @derive tags and gates on it: every exported column has exactly one tag, the tagged lines mention the variable, every source exists in SDTM or ADaM, and every dataset, variable and PARAMCD the spec demands was produced.

steps.name: Generate Define-XML
steps.description: Deterministic. Writes define.xml (Define-XML 2.1, ADaMIG) from the executed datasets and the lineage: types, lengths and labels as delivered; origin and predecessor per variable; one method per derived variable pointing at its program lines.

steps.name: Return result
steps.description: Deterministic. outcome = derived (publishes adam .xpt, programs, logs, lineage.json, define.xml into the study package) or failed (gates still failing after the last attempt; publishes programs and logs, package data unchanged).
